data_fields.name: armour_threshold_and_resistance
data_fields.donor_constant: DT subtracted flat, then DR percent of remainder; 20 percent of both on bypass

best_idea: Take the armour order from the donor (flat threshold first, then percent resistance on what remains, with threshold and resistance both cut to 20 percent for bypass or penetrating hits), and a d100 check whose critical band grows with the margin over the difficulty.
decision_why: Keep the flat-then-percent armour step and the margin-based crit band as fight data per slot; drop the unexplained halving (set divisor 1), the probable Luck double count in First Aid, the first-game-day critical gate (a time limit) and the party-member substitution (conflicts with one ledger).
acceptance: A server test asserts raw 20 against DT 4 and DR 20 percent gives 13 with no halving, that raw 4 against DT 4 gives 0, and that a bypass hit uses 20 percent of DT and DR.
